title: Creator
summary: A channel hub: explain what you make, pair it with one subscribe action, and give selected work more room than platform links.

notFor: People who mainly want to show written or reported work (start from journalist)

cards.purpose: Explain the subject and audience so a new visitor understands the channel.
One primary subscribe destination and a complementary newsletter.
Three or four selected videos with a useful topic, duration and description.
Partnership fit and an approved business contact.
Other channels, without competing with the main subscription.
The making process and disclosure policy, if the creator wants to share them.

slots.ask: What name do you publish under?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji. This appears in the About popover, not beside the name; repeat the essential purpose in the first text card.

slots.ask: Who is this page for, what do you make or offer, and what should a new visitor understand first?
slots.write: Use a short descriptive heading and two sentences: identify the person or group, the work and the audience. The header shows only the name; this card must explain the purpose. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What is the one thing you most want a visitor to do: subscribe, join a newsletter, support you?
slots.write: The first button is the main action. Use preset=subscribe for a channel or newsletter; otherwise leave preset absent and supply a two-to-four-word label. Keep the pitch heading and text tied to the separate answered slots. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Which three or four recent pieces should visitors see first?
slots.write: tag = format · length; title = the published title; the member uploads each thumbnail in the editor. Use only links they give you. Select up to four featured entries for this page; link to the complete archive or catalogue instead of deleting the person’s remaining work. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you want brands to contact you? If so, which email address may be public?
slots.write: Publish an email only if they confirm it may be public. Text = what kind of brands they work with. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Which platforms do you post on? Paste your profile links.
slots.write: The URL only; add a label only where the URL names no account. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: How did you start, and is there anything every viewer should know (how you disclose sponsorships, for example)?
slots.write: Two or three short lines, in their voice. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a photo, artwork or logo you want to upload as the profile picture?
slots.write: The person uploads their chosen picture in the editor. Never fetch, generate or infer a personal photo. Use their description for alt text wherever the editor asks for it.
